title: P2LRN Progression Profile
description: Optional portable progression rules for marking course content as required and, when explicitly requested, gating later content until completion conditions are met.
rules: Packages that do not declare this profile MUST retain ordinary free navigation behavior.
required=true marks an entity as required for progression/completion semantics but MUST NOT by itself block navigation.
gateFollowing=true blocks later siblings at the same hierarchy level until the gated entity is satisfied.
unlockWhen applies only to the entity carrying it and can express all/any prerequisite conditions.
completionRequirement defaults to completed and MAY be viewed, completed or passed.
minScore is a percentage from 0 to 100 and is only valid on activity entities.
Navigation-affecting rules (gateFollowing or unlockWhen) MUST declare this profile with manifest requirement required.
A unit gate is satisfied by all descendant activities marked required; when none are explicitly required, all descendant activities participate.
Learner state is operational state and MUST remain outside the portable package.
